title: Church leaders: Regeneration & Reconciliation
description: Church leaders  Bind your scale to responsibility.
content:
## Church leaders

Bind your scale to responsibility. (1) *Universal-Body growth*: treat other congregations' flourishing as your metric too — share what you do well, and let planting, building, or relocating regenerate the places you leave. (2) *Operational regeneration*: right-size buildings and debt, run on renewable energy, design for walking/biking/transit, extend the church's capacity into health care, social services, and income stabilization. (3) *Institutional repentance* (received from Module 4): exceed legal minimums on sexual misconduct, tax law, and equity — racial and class — boldly and publicly; doing more than required is how broken institutions rebuild trust. (4) *Outcome-honest discernment*: we cannot be a community serving the poor, prisoners, immigrants, orphans, and widows while supporting, from whichever side of the aisle, what measurably leaves those same neighbors poorer, more endangered, or more alone — we cannot go on sinning that grace may abound. Judge every political commitment the congregation holds, whatever its direction, by measurable outcomes, not stated goals — and inspect your own side's fruit first. (5) *Vocation support*: build ministry capacity that helps members realign their work with their values.
